description: Scaffold the entire project: Vite+React+TS in the workspace root, Capacitor 7 initialization, Android platform, all plugins at pinned versions, copy source files, create alertEngine.d.ts, and configure capacitor.config.ts.
steps: Step 1 — Initialize Vite project: run `npm create vite@latest . -- --template react-ts` inside the workspace root `c:/Users/filip/Documents/Codes/radar detector`. When prompted that the directory is not empty, choose to ignore/overwrite. This creates package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig*.json, index.html, src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx, src/vite-env.d.ts.
Step 2 — Install Capacitor core and CLI at exact versions: `npm install --save-exact @capacitor/core@7.6.10` and `npm install --save-exact --save-dev @capacitor/cli@7.6.10`.

Step 3 — Initialize Capacitor: run `npx cap init 'Radares PR' com.pessoal.radarespr --web-dir dist`. This creates capacitor.config.ts (or .json — prefer .ts). If a capacitor.config.ts is created, verify it has appId='com.pessoal.radarespr' and appName='Radares PR' and webDir='dist'.
Step 4 — Install Android platform: `npm install --save-exact @capacitor/android@7.6.10` then `npx cap add android`.

Step 5 — Install plugins at exact pinned versions: `npm install --save-exact @capacitor/preferences@7.0.1 @capacitor-community/background-geolocation@1.3.1 @capacitor-community/text-to-speech@6.1.0 @capacitor-community/keep-awake@7.1.0`.

Step 6 — Copy source files: copy `alertEngine.js` from workspace root to `src/lib/alertEngine.js` (create `src/lib/` directory). Copy `radares_pr.json` from workspace root to `src/data/radares_pr.json` (create `src/data/` directory). Do NOT modify either file.

Step 7 — Create `src/lib/alertEngine.d.ts` with complete TypeScript declarations. Export: interface `AlertEvent` with fields id(number), tipo(string), etapa(1|2), mensagem(string), distM(number), limiteKmh(number|null), acimaDoLimite(boolean), visual('amarelo'|'vermelho_piscando'), som('aviso'|'alarme'), titulo(string). Interface `Position` with lat(number), lon(number), velKmh(number), heading(number|null|undefined). Interface `EngineConfig` matching all fields of CONFIG_PADRAO. Interface `DatasetJson` with meta(object) and pontos(Array<[number,number,string,number]>). Export class `AlertEngine` with constructor(dados: DatasetJson, config?: Partial<EngineConfig>) and method atualizar(pos: Position): AlertEvent[]. Export const `CONFIG_PADRAO: EngineConfig`. Export function `distanciaM(lat1: number, lon1: number, lat2: number, lon2: number): number`.

Step 8 — Create `src/types.ts` with shared interfaces: `AppSettings` (tiposAtivos: string[], vozAtiva: boolean, volume: number, manterTela: boolean, avisarAcimaLimite: boolean), `UserPoint` (id: string, lat: number, lon: number, tipo: string, limite: number, criadoEm: number), `DatasetJson` re-exported from alertEngine.d.ts or redeclared here.

Step 9 — Replace the scaffolded `src/App.tsx` with a minimal placeholder that renders '
Radares PR
' and compiles cleanly. Replace `src/App.css` (or delete it) to avoid import errors. Update `src/main.tsx` to not import any removed files.
Step 10 — Run `npm run build` and confirm exit 0 with no TypeScript errors. Run `npx cap sync` and confirm exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
`src/lib/alertEngine.js` is byte-for-byte identical to the original `alertEngine.js` at workspace root
`src/data/radares_pr.json` is byte-for-byte identical to the original `radares_pr.json` at workspace root
`src/lib/alertEngine.d.ts` exists and TypeScript can resolve imports of `AlertEngine`, `AlertEvent`, and `CONFIG_PADRAO` from it
`android/` directory exists (created by `npx cap add android`)
package.json lists all 7 packages at the exact pinned versions from the version matrix
verification: Run `fc /b alertEngine.js src\lib\alertEngine.js` (Windows) — must report no differences
findings: 1. TypeScript 7.x (generated by Vite scaffold with typescript@~7.0.2) broke Capacitor CLI's internal ts-node loading of capacitor.config.ts — `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'CommonJS')`. Workaround: capacitor.config.ts was replaced with capacitor.config.json (plain JSON). This is fully supported by Capacitor 7 and has no functional impact. Later FEATs that reference capacitor.config.ts should use capacitor.config.json instead. 2. `npm create vite@latest . -- --template react-ts` no longer works with npm 11 (the --template flag is treated as a positional arg). Use `npx create-vite@latest . --template react-ts` instead. 3. Vite scaffold (create-vite v9) chose Oxlint as linter and installed TypeScript ~7.0.2 — no ESLint config present. 4. PowerShell aliases `fc` to `Format-Custom`; use `cmd /c "fc /b ..."` for binary comparisons. 5. `npx cap add android` emits `[warn] sync could not run--missing dist directory` if run before `npm run build`; this is benign — sync runs fine after the dist is built.
